passages.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He deserves thanks.
Give thanks to the LORD.
Call on His name.
Tell people about what He has done.
Make His deeds known among all nations.
passages.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God does wonderful things.
Sing to God.
Sing praises to God.
Tell about all the wonderful things God has done.
passages.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־ נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
His name is holy.
Honor His holy name.
People who seek the LORD have joy in their hearts.
Let those who seek the LORD rejoice.
passages.original: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is strong.
Seek the LORD.
Seek His strength.
Always look for His presence.
passages.original: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃

passages.text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced, O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
passages.sermon:
God chose Abraham as His servant.
God chose the sons of Jacob as His special people.
God did many wonders.
God performed great marvels.
God spoke judgments with His mouth.
You are Abraham’s descendants.
You are Jacob’s children.
You are God’s chosen ones.
Remember what God has done.
Remember His wonders.
Remember His marvels.
Remember His judgments.
passages.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־ פִֽיו׃ זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃

passages.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He rules over us.
His judgments reach everywhere on earth.
No place is outside His rule.
He decides what is right in all the world.
passages.original: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל־ הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃

passages.text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations— the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
passages.sermon:
God remembers His covenant forever.
He never forgets His promise.
He established His word for a thousand generations.
He made a covenant with Abraham.
He swore an oath to Isaac.
passages.original: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃

passages.text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is our God.
God made judgments for the whole earth.
God confirmed His covenant to Jacob.
God made this covenant a decree for Jacob.
God made this covenant an everlasting covenant for Israel.
God said, “I will give you the land of Canaan.”
God said, “This land will be your inheritance.”
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־ אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land, they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel were few in number.
They were very few.
They lived as strangers in the land.
They moved from one nation to another nation.
They went from one kingdom to another people.
passages.original: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃ וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־ גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־ עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

passages.text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
passages.sermon:
God protected His chosen people, Israel.
God did not allow anyone to oppress them.
God rebuked kings for their sake.
God said, “Do not touch My anointed ones.”
God said, “Do no harm to My prophets.”
passages.original: לֹֽא־ הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃ אַֽל־ תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל־ תָּרֵֽעוּ׃

passages.text: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God called for a famine on the land.
God caused all the food supplies to be cut off.
No bread remained in the land.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל־ מַטֵּה־ לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃

passages.text: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
passages.sermon:
God acted first.
God sent a man ahead of His people.
This man was Joseph.
People sold Joseph as a slave.
passages.original: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃

passages.text: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons, until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was a man.
People sold Joseph as a slave.
They hurt Joseph’s feet with shackles.
They put Joseph’s neck in irons.
Joseph suffered in prison.
He stayed there until his prediction came true.
The word of the LORD tested Joseph.
The word of the LORD proved Joseph right.
passages.original: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רַגְלָיו בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ עַד־ עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא־ דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃

passages.text: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was in prison in Egypt.
The king of Egypt sent for Joseph.
The king released Joseph from prison.
The ruler of many peoples set Joseph free.
passages.original: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance, to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
passages.sermon:
God made Joseph master of the ruler’s house.
God gave Joseph authority over all the ruler’s possessions.
Joseph could command the ruler’s princes as he wished.
Joseph taught wisdom to the ruler’s elders.
passages.original: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל־ קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃ לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃

passages.text: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
passages.sermon:
Israel is the people descended from Jacob.
Jacob is also called Israel.
Jacob and his family went to Egypt.
Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
The land of Ham means Egypt.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ חָֽם׃

passages.text: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes, whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted with power.
He made His people grow greatly in number.
He made His people very fruitful.
He made His people stronger than their enemies.
The LORD changed the hearts of their enemies.
Their enemies began to hate His people.
Their enemies planned evil against His servants.
passages.original: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־ עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃ הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
passages.sermon:
God acted.
God sent Moses.
Moses was God's servant.
God also sent Aaron.
God chose Aaron.
passages.original: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
passages.sermon:
God chose Moses and Aaron as His servants.
God sent Moses and Aaron to the people of Egypt.
Moses and Aaron performed God's miraculous signs among the Egyptians.
Moses and Aaron did wonders in the land of Ham.
The land of Ham means Egypt.
passages.original: שָֽׂמוּ־ בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃

passages.text: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power in Egypt.
God sent darkness over the land.
The land became dark.
The people did not obey God’s words.
They defied what God commanded.
passages.original: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־ דְּבָרָוו׃

passages.text: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
passages.sermon: God acted with power in Egypt.\r\nHe turned their water into blood.\r\nTheir fish died.
passages.original: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־ מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־ דְּגָתָֽם׃

passages.text: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
passages.sermon: God sent frogs.\r\nFrogs filled their land.\r\nFrogs entered the rooms of their kings.
passages.original: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power in Egypt.
God spoke.
Insects swarmed everywhere.
Gnats filled the whole country.
passages.original: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃

passages.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
passages.sermon: God acted with power.\r\nHe changed their rain into hail.\r\nHe sent fire and lightning across their land.
passages.original: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃

passages.text: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
He struck their vines.
He struck their fig trees.
He shattered the trees in their country.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃

passages.text: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God spoke.
Locusts came immediately.
Countless young locusts appeared.
No one could count them.
passages.original: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

passages.text: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
passages.sermon: Locusts came into the land of Egypt.\r\nThey ate every plant in Egypt.\r\nThey consumed all the produce that grew from Egypt’s soil.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃

passages.text: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
He struck all the firstborn in Egypt.
He struck the first and best of their strength.
He did this in their own land.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל־ אוֹנָֽם׃

passages.text: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
passages.sermon:
God brought Israel out of Egypt.
He gave them silver and gold.
No one in Israel's tribes stumbled.
Everyone left strong and unharmed.
passages.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃

passages.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
passages.sermon:
Egypt felt glad when Israel left.
Egypt had become afraid of Israel.
Fear of Israel had come upon Egypt.
This fear caused Egypt to rejoice at Israel’s departure.
passages.original: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־ נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
passages.sermon:
God led Israel out of Egypt.
God spread a cloud over them.
The cloud covered them.
God gave them protection with the cloud.
God also gave them fire at night.
The fire gave them light in the darkness.
passages.original: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
passages.sermon: The Israelites asked God for food.\r\nGod brought them quail.\r\nGod satisfied the Israelites with bread from heaven.
passages.original: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃

passages.text: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God opened a rock.
Water gushed out from the rock.
The water flowed in the desert.
The water moved like a river.
passages.original: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃

passages.text: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
passages.sermon: God remembered His holy promise.\r\nGod made this promise to Abraham.\r\nAbraham was God's servant.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ זָ֭כַר אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־ אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
passages.sermon:
God led His people out.
He did this with great rejoicing.
God brought out His chosen ones.
They shouted for joy.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־ בְּחִירָֽיו׃

passages.text: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor, that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
God gave His people the lands of other nations.
God let His people inherit what other peoples had worked for.
God did this so His people would keep His statutes.
God did this so His people would obey His laws.
Praise the Lord!
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃ בַּעֲב֤וּר׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
